page.overview:
Who is Hantengu?

Hantengu belongs to Demon Slayer. Over two centuries ago, Hantengu was once a prolific thief and murderer, whose victims comprised of people who condemned his duplicitous actions.

He was sentenced to death as an elderly man but was visited by Muzan Kibutsuji whilst awaiting his execution, who transformed him into a demon and gave the criminal a new life. class="portal" style="border: 3px ridge #5e111f;" | ! class="portal" style="border: 3px ridge #5e111f;" | !
